localFindings.description: Run-01: NatSpec did not state first-empty-pool termination. Now stated.

Two inaccuracies vs deployed Router NG v1.1: (a) k=0 - the router does not deliver _route[0] when _route[1]==0; hop 0 always executes and reverts on the zero swap address; (b) _pools[h] is used only by swap_type 3, not 3/5/7. Neither changes on-chain behaviour; (b) could mislead a future validator that ties pools to swap_type.

externalEntryPoints.notes: Pulls _amount of _route[0] from caller via transferFrom; pays final token to _receiver; _expected is the only slippage guard (harvester passes 0). Semantics (v1.1): hop 0 always executes; after hop i break if i==4 or _route[2i+3]==0; deliver _route[2k] (minus 1 wei retained) or revert. Per-hop reverts: zero token -> empty data; unknown swap_type -> Error("Bad swap type"); zero balance delta -> Error("Received nothing"); final < _expected -> Error("Slippage").

trustAssumptions: Router NG immutable deployment is the target; payable but harvester never sends value.
Interface is version-agnostic; v1.1 vs v1.2 differ in accepted swap_type set (v1.2 adds 9) and swap_type 8 token pairs. Harvester binds the version via its immutable constructor arg, unchecked.
